description: FIX_MOVE_FOR_CHARGE review fix (ships OFF): an attached leader standing in front of its squad never prices the charge — the AI's own charge move (_compute_charge_move) moves only the bodyguard's models and the engine moves the leader by their delta afterwards, so the leader makes a target selectable (11.04, from the whole Attached unit) but the bodyguard must make the move. The fixture's Blade Champion A is attached to U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B (CharacterAttachmentManager.attach_character, after can_attach) 2.8" in front of the squad; Custodian Guard Gamma is a row 8" beyond the leader, off to the east. With tests/bench_profiles/move_for_charge_on.json loaded, clicking the real Suggest (K) button and focusing the squad shows 'this turn's charge needs a 4+ on 2D6 (92%) (its attached leader is nearest, but the bodyguard makes the charge move, ...)' and the action 'moves to attack Custodian Guard Gamma'; the claimed 4+ is the first roll at which BOTH the engine offers the target and the AI's own charge move completes (the old pricing claimed a 3+ here). Clearing the profile shows the shipped default (no claim, no note); reloading and executing through AIPlayer moves squad and leader together and the engine's own state needs the same 4+.
